name: shva
description: Personal command pack for Shiva. v0.1.0 ships /shva:brief-me — domain-agnostic pre-project vocabulary briefing for any GenAI build (code, design, video, music, art). Returns a 20-25 term glossary in three buckets (Creative/Style · Technical/Process · Prompt/Direction), asks 3 clarifying questions, and provides a correction-coda prompt that turns Claude into a real-time vocabulary coach. The 5-minute step that prevents 5-hour AI drifts.
